483-574-1981-2415.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
483-574-1981-2415.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2267-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2267-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

618-3817-5231.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
Repeat.

719-3413-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Xenograft, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

290-1978-7714.description:
Cast Dreamstone Hedron by paying its mana cost.
When Dreamstone Hedron enters, Ultron triggers.
Holding priority, activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Dreamstone Hedron that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
During your next turn, activate the Dreamstone Hedron token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Dreamstone Hedron token.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2079-3259-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

891-2438-7424.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1432-1486-1753-7223.notablePrerequisites: Stalactite Dagger on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1432-1486-1753-7223.description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Samut and another legendary creature if desired.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping the targeted creature(s).
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.
1432-1486-1753-7223.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

3767-3918-5396-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
3767-3918-5396-7013.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

3446-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

443-2073-6808.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 13 or higher.
You control a creature with power 2 or greater.
443-2073-6808.description:
Activate The Last Ride's crew ability by tapping a creature with power 2 or greater, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
The Last Ride dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Salvaging Station and Magus of the Bridge.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Salvaging Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

678-2511-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
678-2511-6749.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, causing you to return Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Anticausal Vestige trigger, causing you to reveal the top cards of your library and put it into your graveyard if its a creature card, or draw a card otherwise, and then put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1020-2866-6518-6747.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2275-3591-5436-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2275-3591-5436-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

325-1786-4067-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-1786-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

2051-3946-4011.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional land.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2051-3946-4011.description:
Play Glacial Chasm.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
If Life from the Loam is in your graveyard, during your draw step, choose to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand instead of drawing a card.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Glacial Chasm and at least one other land from your graveyard to your hand.
Play any land except Glacial Chasm.
Repeat.

1976-5078-5642.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1017-1656-2335-4041.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1017-1656-2335-4041.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Merfolk Looter's ability by tapping it, causing you to loot.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

45-132-3525.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Khalni Gem's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

262-2335-3386.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Nurturing Presence attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness, and has a power of one or greater.
262-2335-3386.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
When the Elemental token(s) enter the battlefield, Barrenton Medic triggers that many times, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature that entered the battlefield.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Barrenton Medic has a power of two or greater, it also becomes infinitely large until end of turn.

1335-2440-4050.manaNeeded: {R}{G}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1335-2440-4050.description:
Cast Marath from the command zone by paying {R}{G}{W} and commander tax, if applicable, causing it to enter the battlefield with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Marath enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental and Beast on the battlefield.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental on the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3 until Marath has one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Marath dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Choose to return Marath to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Marath ability, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental on the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing three Elementals, adding {R}{G}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colorless mana and Elemental tokens, you may cast Marath, causing it to enter with an arbitrarily large number of +1/+1 counters, and choose Marath's other modes instead.

512-950-3990.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce {W}.
Incubation Druid and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-950-3990.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Incubation Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-950-3990.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Incubation Druid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

2034-3249-4242.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Su-Chi.
Cast Su-Chi from graveyard by paying {4}.
Repeat.
